title: NEX-Laminate v1.0: A provenance-controlled numerical-experimental evidence package for inverse laminate design
description: Ten thousand symmetric and balanced IM7/8552 laminate designs with deterministic Classical Lamination Theory labels, public NCAMP experimental material-property summary statistics, group-safe splits, and a frozen protocol for paired physical validation.
